title: About MedSupply Pro
description: Learn about our mission to deliver quality medical supplies to healthcare professionals.

meta.title: About Us
meta.description: MedSupply Pro has been a trusted medical supplier since 1998.

content:
Founded in 1998, MedSupply Pro has grown from a small regional distributor to one of the nation's leading online medical supply retailers. We serve hospitals, clinics, dental offices, veterinary practices, and home healthcare providers across all 50 states.

Our team includes licensed pharmacists, certified medical equipment specialists, and dedicated customer support professionals who understand the unique needs of healthcare facilities.

Our Commitment

  • FDA-registered and compliant sourcing
  • Same-day shipping on in-stock items
  • Volume pricing for institutional buyers
  • 24/7 expert support
